title: Essential OF Beginner
description: Vanilla + for beginner with multiplayer ability (Essential mod)
body:
This modpack is designed to provide a lightweight and smooth Minecraft experience focused on multiplayer gameplay. It includes a selection of essential and basic mods that improve quality of life, enhance performance, and make playing with friends easier and more enjoyable—without overwhelming the game with unnecessary features.



Whether you’re hosting a small server or playing casually with friends, this pack keeps things simple, stable, and fun. Perfect for anyone who wants the “just enough mods” experience for cooperative adventures.

Mods list :

> Sodium
> Lithium
> Iris Shaders
> Dynamic FPS
> ImmediatlyFast
> Essential Mod
> Zoomify
> Mouse Tweaks
